<thought>Based on the observed ESI‑MS peak at m/z 194.086, the neutral monoisotopic mass of the compound is ≈ 193.079 Da. This mass matches the known monoisotopic mass of caffeine (C₈H₁₀N₄O₂, 193.079 Da). Therefore the molecular formula of the analyzed compound is C₈H₁₀N₄O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H10N4O2</final_answer>
